name: tether-sync
description: Work on any SSH server while every extension runs on your own machine. Two-way file sync, remote terminal and port forwarding. Nothing is installed on the server.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Work on a server without installing anything on it.
[Connect Folder…](command:tether.connectFolder)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Tether
walkthroughs.description: Edit files on a server with all your extensions running locally.

steps.title: Connect to your server
steps.description:
Pick a server and a folder. Tether makes a working copy on this computer and keeps both sides in sync.
[Connect Folder…](command:tether.connectFolder)

steps.title: Run things on the server
steps.description:
Open a terminal that runs on the server, already in your project folder.
[Remote Terminal](command:tether.openTerminal)

steps.title: Watch the status bar
steps.description: The item at the bottom left always tells you whether you are in sync. Click it for Sync Now, port forwarding, conflicts, and everything else.

tether.autoConnect.description: When you open a paired folder that was still connected last time (you closed the editor without Disconnect), reconnect and sync automatically. Disconnect opts out until you reconnect manually.

tether.ignore.markdownDescription: Files and folders that are never synced, in `.gitignore` syntax. You can also put patterns in a `.tetherignore` or `.connectignore` file in the project root.

tether.respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Also skip everything listed in the project's root `.gitignore`. Off by default because ignored files such as `.env` are often needed on the server.

tether.maxFileSizeMB.description: Files larger than this are left alone on both sides. 0 means no limit.

tether.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to look for changes made on the server. Local changes are always sent immediately. 0 turns periodic checks off.

enumDescriptions: Show the file in the status bar and let me decide.
Keep my version and save the server version next to it.
tether.conflictPolicy.description: What to do when a file was changed both here and on the server.

tether.confirmDeletesOver.description: Ask before one sync deletes more than this many files.

tether.concurrency.description: How many files to transfer at the same time.

tether.compressTransfers.description: Gzip files above a size threshold before sending them over SSH, then decompress on the other side.

scripts.test:smoke: node esbuild.mjs && node esbuild.mjs --test && node --test test/smoke.test.cjs
